statement: After PipeWriter.CloseWithError(first), a second CloseWithError(second) returns nil without replacing the first error; a later reader receives first.
fragment: CloseWithError never overwrites the previous error

statement: If a six-byte Pipe write has delivered two bytes and the reader closes with an error, the writer returns the two consumed bytes together with that error.
A zero-length Pipe write still participates in a reader handshake; after a matching zero-length Read both return zero and nil.
